categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Screen Micro Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in military electronic component reliability testing and environmental reliability testing services for military equipment and subsystems. Its services include electronic component testing and reliability screening, destructive physical analysis (DPA), failure analysis, and reliability management technical support. The company also engages in wafer testing through its subsidiary Jiangsu Qiwei. It serves a broad range of military electronic components including integrated circuits, discrete devices, optoelectronic devices, and electromechanical components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automatic test equipment (ATE) such as V93000, T5833ES, and J750EX-HD for testing a wide variety of integrated circuits including SOC, MCU, DSP, FPGA, and memory chips. It has developed proprietary test programs and custom test adapters, with over 41,000 test programs and 25,000 adapters. The company also specializes in environmental reliability testing, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing, and destructive physical analysis based on national military standards (GJB), IEC, MIL, and others. It continuously invests in R&D to enhance testing capabilities for emerging technologies like 3D packaging, high-speed AD/DA chips, and satellite communication components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are subsidiaries of major Chinese military-industrial groups and electronic component suppliers supporting these groups. Key clients include China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation, Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, China North Industries Group, China Electronics Technology Group, and others. The end markets are military electronic systems used in aerospace, aviation, naval, missile, and land vehicle applications, including satellite and space communication systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: Chengdu Screen Micro Electronics operates primarily within China, with key testing bases located in Chengdu (Southwest China), Xi'an (Northwest China), and Wuxi (East China). These locations strategically cover major military-industrial clusters in Southwest, Northwest, East, North, Central, South, and Northeast China. The company is expanding its presence with new facilities and projects in Hainan (South China) to support commercial satellite and aerospace industries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a downstream independent third-party service provider in the military electronic components supply chain. It provides reliability testing, screening, and analysis services to component manufacturers and military equipment producers, rather than manufacturing electronic components itself. It supports upstream semiconductor and electronic component manufacturers by validating product reliability and downstream military system integrators by ensuring component quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on building a leading domestic reliability service platform with a dual growth curve approach. It emphasizes deepening core testing and screening services while accelerating new business directions such as environmental testing, EMC, and intelligent testing for low-earth orbit commercial satellites. R&D priorities include developing test technologies for advanced SOC chips, high-speed AD/DA chips, DSP aging tests, and Hall current sensor testing. The company invests heavily in expanding CNAS-accredited testing items, increasing test programs and adapters, and securing intellectual property rights.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of reliability testing and screening services, destructive physical analysis, failure analysis, and technical support services. The company operates a direct sales model targeting military-industrial clients and electronic component manufacturers. Pricing is negotiated based on component types, test complexity, market competition, and service costs. The company also earns income from technology development services and equipment leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading independent third-party military electronic component reliability testing providers in China, competing with military group-affiliated testing institutions and other private testing firms like Xi'an Xigu and Jinghan Yu. It holds a strong market position due to its broad testing capabilities, extensive CNAS and DILAC accreditations, and wide customer base across major military-industrial groups. Its flexible operation and rapid response capabilities provide competitive advantages over state-owned counterparts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 143.8 million, a 28.4% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 21 million. Total assets were about RMB 1.82 billion with shareholders' equity of RMB 1.61 billion. The company increased R&D investment by 9.09% to RMB 24.3 million, representing 16.91% of revenue. Despite recent revenue decline due to military industry adjustments, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology development to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced and comprehensive reliability testing technologies covering a wide range of military electronic components, supported by extensive CNAS and DILAC accreditations. It offers customized test programs and adapters developed in-house, enabling high precision and efficiency. Its multi-regional testing bases allow rapid response to key military-industrial clusters. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, broad patent portfolio, and recognized quality management systems provide customers with trusted, high-quality, and cost-effective reliability assurance services critical for military applications.
